answer: Locks are published in river, expire in anchor, and vertex lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 92 aliases therefore needs 175 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1823 identities would post 4779 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
